title: The Sunday Read: ‘Want to Do Less Time? A Prison Consultant Might Be Able to Help.’

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·荣森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you, and you turned a DJ booth
sentences.zh: 即使在黑胶唱片时代的夜店当DJ时，每晚你也会带着300件最珍爱的藏品去上班，你会把DJ台

sentences.en: into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 变成这样一个充满活力的快闪博物馆，摆满精美的50年历史的艺术品。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 立即在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听来自爱彼的《重构者》。

sentences.en: Imagine you're a person just living your normal, unremarkable life.
sentences.zh: 想象一下，你只是一个过着普通、平凡生活的人。

sentences.en: But then you slip into, whether accidentally or on purpose, a life of crime, and you get caught.
sentences.zh: 但随后你无论是无意还是故意，踏入了犯罪生涯，然后被抓了。

sentences.en: Now your normal life is gone.
sentences.zh: 现在你平淡的生活不复存在了。

sentences.en: Your reputation is ruined.
sentences.zh: 你的名誉扫地。

sentences.en: You're depressed.
sentences.zh: 你感到沮丧。

sentences.en: Your family, too, is in despair.
sentences.zh: 你的家人也陷入绝望。

sentences.en: Your spouse, your kids.
sentences.zh: 你的配偶，你的孩子。

sentences.en: And you're going to leave them behind while you go to prison.
sentences.zh: 而你入狱时却要把他们抛在身后。

sentences.en: And because maybe you know nothing about prison, one of the things you might do is to start madly Googling, say, will I get assaulted in prison?
sentences.zh: 由于你可能对监狱一无所知，你可能会做的一件事就是疯狂地在谷歌上搜索，比如，我在监狱里会被袭击吗？

sentences.en: Or what's the first thing that happens in prison?
sentences.zh: 或者监狱里发生的第一件事是什么？

sentences.en: You might want to find out, what's life behind bars really like?
sentences.zh: 你可能想知道，铁窗后的生活到底是什么样的？

sentences.en: And when you search for answers to these questions, your results will send you straight to the websites of prison consulting firMs.
sentences.zh: 当你搜索这些问题的答案时，你的搜索结果会直接将你带到监狱咨询公司的网站。

sentences.en: My name is Jack Hitt.
sentences.zh: 我叫杰克·希特。

sentences.en: I'm a contributing writer to the New York Times magazine.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报杂志》的特约撰稿人。

sentences.en: A few years ago, I was reading about the Varsity Blue scandal.
sentences.zh: 几年前，我正在阅读关于“大学入学丑闻”的报道。

sentences.en: That was the story where a lot of wealthy, prominent people engineered their children's acceptance to major league universities all over the country.
sentences.zh: 那是一个许多富有、显赫的人为他们的孩子被全国各地的顶尖大学录取而进行运作的故事。

sentences.en: And after they got caught, I saw that some of them had hired these consultants to be their advisors on their journey to prison.
sentences.zh: 在我看到他们被捕后，我发现其中一些人雇用了这些顾问作为他们监狱之旅的顾问。

sentences.en: And I thought, wait a minute, what?
sentences.zh: 我想，等一下，什么？

sentences.en: I'm familiar with McKinsey.
sentences.zh: 我对麦肯锡很熟悉。

sentences.en: I'm familiar with political consultants.
sentences.zh: 我对政治顾问很熟悉。

sentences.en: But really?
sentences.zh: 但真的吗？

sentences.en: Prison consultants?
sentences.zh: 监狱顾问？

sentences.en: And it turns out, it's a thriving industry.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，这是一个蓬勃发展的行业。

sentences.en: An industry that sells you different strategies about how not only to lighten your sentence, but also to cope with what can be the most despairing weeks and months of your life
sentences.zh: 这个行业向你出售各种策略，不仅教你如何减轻刑期，还教你如何应对你人生中最绝望的几周和几个月，

sentences.en: as you come to terms with a future behind bars.
sentences.zh: 当你不得不接受铁窗后的未来时。

sentences.en: We all associate justice with the phrase, innocent until proven guilty.
sentences.zh: 我们总是把正义与“未经审判证明有罪前无罪”这句话联系在一起。

sentences.en: But actually, over the course of the 20th and 21st centuries,
sentences.zh: 但实际上，在20和21世纪的过程中，

sentences.en: America's presumed innocent criminal justice system has transmogrified into a presumed guilty system.
sentences.zh: 美国假定无罪的刑事司法系统已经蜕变成了一个假定有罪的系统。

sentences.en: At the federal level, about 98% of the people who were charged with a crime in 2021 pled out.
sentences.zh: 在联邦层面，2021年被控犯罪的人中约有98%选择认罪求刑。

sentences.en: They said they were guilty in order to avoid a trial.
sentences.zh: 他们为了避免审判而承认自己有罪。

sentences.en: The all-American ideal of going to trial is mostly a TV trope these days.
sentences.zh: 如今，全美式的出庭受审理想主要只是电视上的老套桥段。

sentences.en: I haven't done the math, but it's possible that there are more trials on primetime TV than there are in America's courthouses.
sentences.zh: 我没有算过，但黄金时段电视上的审判次数可能比美国法院里的还要多。

sentences.en: In the real world, the time to argue your innocence is over.
sentences.zh: 在现实世界中，争论你是否无罪的时刻已经过去。

sentences.en: You're going to be sentenced.
sentences.zh: 你将面临判决。

sentences.en: And if you're going to go on this bureaucratic journey, there's a conveyor belt of decisions right up to the front door.
sentences.zh: 如果你要踏上这段官僚主义的旅程，从现在到大门口有一连串的决定等着你。

sentences.en: Like, which prison are you going to?
sentences.zh: 比如，你要去哪所监狱？

sentences.en: Will my cell be comfortable?
sentences.zh: 我的单间会舒服吗？

sentences.en: What kind of people will be around me?
sentences.zh: 我身边会是什么样的人？

sentences.en: All of these decisions will have a profound effect on your life for perhaps a very long time.
sentences.zh: 所有这些决定都将对你的生活产生深远的影响，或许会持续很长时间。

sentences.en: For example, some prisons have really good schools.
sentences.zh: 例如，有些监狱有非常好的学校。

sentences.en: Some have outstanding athletic facilities, if that's what you want.
sentences.zh: 如果你喜欢的话，有些监狱拥有出色的运动设施。

sentences.en: The prison consultants I profiled know these things because all of them are ex-valens who have served time in different prisons around the country.
sentences.zh: 我采访过的监狱顾问深谙此道，因为他们都是曾在全国各地不同监狱服过刑的前白领罪犯。

sentences.en: For this story, I profiled a man named Hugo Mejia who had recently pled guilty to a felony and I spent almost a year with him.
sentences.zh: 对于这篇报道，我采访了一个名叫雨果·梅地亚的人，他最近承认了一项重罪，我和他在一起待了将近一年。

sentences.en: In that time, he hired prison advisors who allowed me to sit in on their consultations.
sentences.zh: 在那期间，他雇用了监狱顾问，这让我得以旁听他们的咨询过程。

sentences.en: I was basically a fly on the wall with Mejia as he made his way to prison where he is today.
sentences.zh: 我和梅地亚在一起时基本上就是个隐形旁观者，看着他一步步走向他如今所在的监狱。

sentences.en: It all started so innocently.
sentences.zh: 这一切开始时是那么天真无邪。

sentences.en: Back when Bitcoin was new, there were people who wanted to flip Bitcoin for dollars and others who needed dollars for Bitcoin.
sentences.zh: 早在比特币刚出现的时候，有些人想把比特币换成美元，而另一些人则需要美元来买比特币。

sentences.en: In these early days of cryptocurrency, going from dollars to Bitcoin or vice versa wasn't as easy as it is now.
sentences.zh: 在加密货币的早期，从美元换成比特币或反之，并不像现在这么容易。

sentences.en: But Mejia figured out how to make it simple enough.
sentences.zh: 但梅地亚想出了如何让它变得足够简单的方法。

sentences.en: He became a human ATM, balancing a trade of Bitcoin with a trade of dollars and charging a little VIG each way.
sentences.zh: 他成了一个活体自动取款机，平衡比特币交易与美元交易，并在每笔交易中收取一点回扣（VIG）。

sentences.en: I'd make 150 bucks for the day, he said, and that was my day.
sentences.zh: 他说，我一天能赚150美元，这就是我的一天。

sentences.en: That was my hustle.
sentences.zh: 这就是我的生财之道。

sentences.en: Word got around and Mejia got new customers, some of whom wanted to change quite a bit more money than he was accustomed to.
sentences.zh: 消息传开了，梅地亚迎来了新客户，其中一些人想要兑换的金额比他习惯的要多得多。

sentences.en: Now, I'm not a stupid person, he told me.
sentences.zh: 现在，我不是个笨人，他告诉我。

sentences.en: I knew these individuals weren't involved in the horse and concession trade like they said.
sentences.zh: 我知道这些人根本不是像他们说的那样从事马匹和特许经营贸易。

sentences.en: This was getting out of control and I was in too deep.
sentences.zh: 这开始失控了，我陷得太深了。

sentences.en: He was putting 2,000 miles a week on his car, picking up suitcases filled with as much as $150,000, even $250,000 in cash, which he would have to take home until he could work out
sentences.zh: 他每周开车2000英里，去取装满现金的手提箱，金额高达15万甚至25万美元现金，他必须把这些钱带回家，直到他能处理好

sentences.en: the Bitcoin flip.
sentences.zh: 比特币交易。

sentences.en: He asked me, so if you had that kind of money, Jack, for example, if I may, under your bed, could you sleep comfortably?
sentences.zh: 他问我，杰克，如果你有那种钱，比如说，如果可以的话，放在你的床底下，你能睡得安稳吗？

sentences.en: Really?
sentences.zh: 真的吗？

sentences.en: Suddenly, he was demanding a lot more from his Xanax.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，他对阿普唑仑的需求大增。

sentences.en: It went from nervousness and stress to fear and depression, he said, all of which found creative ways to express itself.
sentences.zh: 他说，这从紧张和压力变成了恐惧和沮丧，所有这些都通过各种有创意的方式表现出来。

sentences.en: One day, he woke up to find his eyes were bleeding from the inside.
sentences.zh: 有一天，他醒来发现自己的眼睛在内部出血。

sentences.en: Mejia was diagnosed with retinopathy and began getting regular injections into his eyeballs to save his sight.
sentences.zh: 梅地亚被诊断出患有视网膜病变，并开始定期往眼球里注射药物以挽救视力。

sentences.en: Then, one very early morning last winter, it all fell apart.
sentences.zh: 然后，在去年冬天的某个极早的早晨，一切都崩溃了。

sentences.en: Some 25 federal agents from a joint Homeland Security and IRS task force stormed his house in Ontario, California.
sentences.zh: 来自国土安全部和国税局联合工作组的大约25名联邦特工突袭了他位于加利福尼亚州安大略的家。

sentences.en: They pounced on my home like I was El Chapo, he said.
sentences.zh: 他说，他们扑向我的家，就像我是大毒枭矮子华金·古斯曼一样。

sentences.en: His aunt and mother were handcuffed, and Mejia was detained in his den by agents who grilled him for hours.
sentences.zh: 他的阿姨和母亲被戴上手铐，梅地亚在书房里被特工扣留，并被盘问了几个小时。

sentences.zh: 梅地亚，一名美国

sentences.zh: 他一直认为自己是个努力工作的普通人。

sentences.zh: 他是一项更大调查的目标。

sentences.zh: 联邦当局真正想要的是梅地亚为其经手资金的某个家伙的身份，但梅地亚说他从未见过这个人。

sentences.zh: 他很快建议进行认罪坦白协商，达成一笔交易，但联邦调查局想了解更多关于他的客户的信息。

sentences.zh: 梅地亚坚称自己知道得并不多，发现自己陷入了绝境。

sentences.zh: 但随后，

sentences.zh: 梅地亚很喜欢这个人，花了好几个小时看他的视频。

sentences.zh: 他说，这有点能平息我的焦虑。

sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人在宾至如归的实用小贴士。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是那种对光线极度敏感、一关灯就能秒睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们会不会为了睡觉而喝断片。

sentences.en: I mean what kind of light do they require because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 我是指他们需要什么样的光线环境，因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或饮食禁忌吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们习惯喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 欢迎在《纽约时报》App或您常用的播客平台上收听《Wirecutter秀》。
